title: Drunk man arrested for attempting to attack police officer in Thrissur
content: Thrissur: A 41-year-old man was arrested on charges of trespassing into the Wadakkanchery police station and attempting to assault a police officer while using abusive language. Police said the accused was intoxicated at the time of the incident. The accused was identified as Moinudheen alias Faisal, a resident of Chathankkotta near the Wadakkanchery court. According to the police, the incident occurred around 10 pm on Monday when Moinudheen allegedly entered the police station through the rear gate and confronted Grade Senior Civil Police Officer (GSCPO) M.S. Kannan, who was on duty. He allegedly used abusive language and attempted to attack the officer.The case was registered based on a complaint filed by Kannan. Wadakkanchery police said the accused was booked for obstructing a public servant from discharging official duties, trespassing into the police station and attempting to assault the officer. The accused is now under remand. Police said Moinudheen had a previous history of similar anti-social behaviour. An FIR has been registered in connection with the incident.
